tldr: Mars in the 6th house: drive becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With Mars in the 6th house, this part of you pushes through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. Mars describes drive, anger, courage, desire, defense, and the will to act. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. Mars can become courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear.
gift: courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
